package config

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestLoadRequiresDatabaseAndAllProviderCredentials(t *testing.T) {
	values := validEnvironment()
	delete(values, "CATALOG_INTERNAL_TOKEN")
	_, err := LoadFrom(func(key string) string { return values[key] })
	if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "CATALOG_INTERNAL_TOKEN") {
		t.Fatalf("missing provider credential should name the setting; got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestLoadUsesContractListenerDefaultsAndExactProviderNames(t *testing.T) {
	values := validEnvironment()
	delete(values, "PRACTICE_RUNTIME_HOST")
	delete(values, "PRACTICE_RUNTIME_PORT")
	config, err := LoadFrom(func(key string) string { return values[key] })
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if config.ListenAddress != "127.0.0.1:8080" || config.CatalogBaseURL != "http://catalog:8092" ||
		config.StudentInternalToken != "student-token" || config.ValidationInternalToken != "validation-token" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected loaded config: %+v", config)
	}
}

func validEnvironment() map[string]string {
	return map[string]string{
		"DATABASE_URL":                    "postgres://user:password@localhost:5432/practice_runtime?sslmode=disable",
		"PRACTICE_RUNTIME_INTERNAL_TOKEN": "runtime-token", "TEACHER_SERVICE_TOKEN": "teacher-token",
		"CATALOG_BASE_URL": "http://catalog:8092", "CATALOG_INTERNAL_TOKEN": "catalog-token",
		"STUDENT_BASE_URL": "http://student:8080", "PRACTICE_TASK_INTERNAL_TOKEN": "student-token",
		"LEARNING_PLANNER_BASE_URL": "http://planner:8080", "PRACTICE_TASK_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN": "planner-token",
		"SANDBOX_BASE_URL": "http://sandbox:8080", "SANDBOX_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN": "sandbox-token",
		"VALIDATION_ORCHESTRATOR_BASE_URL": "http://validator:8080", "VALIDATION_ORCHESTRATOR_INTERNAL_TOKEN": "validation-token",
	}
}
